mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that enhance valsartan's hypotensive and hyperkalemic effects, while valsartan may worsen foscarnet-induced renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium), and blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustment of valsartan or alternative antihypertensive; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy.
